text:
priya_k: Heads-up — Activate (ACT-993) showing an embed/token spend spike ~3x this week. Onboarding is ~60% (docs + SSO pending). Need a quick triage before Friday so the QBR doesn't get blindsided.
ethan_m: on it. pulling per-route token burn + recent prompts. any known cron jobs or bulk indexing?
priya_k: Customer says they kicked off a bulk ingest last Tue to reindex kb. Not sure of prompt length. Also reported flaky webhook retries during integration.
ben_finops: budget-bot just flagged ACT-993: CREDIT_THRESHOLD at 85% :rotating_light:. If they keep current pace, they'll hit soft limit by Wed EOD. I can provision a temporary credit bump but want to understand if it's transient.
budget-bot: ALERT: ACT-993 credits_used_pct=85, projected_days_left=1.9. Recent spikes attributed to route: /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate (long-seq).
jas_solutions: Recommend 3 actions: 1) short enablement call to walk through prompt templates and encourage shorter context, 2) enable KV prefix caching for their indexing flow, 3) set a soft throttle on embeds for non-prod. I can run the call tomorrow AM.
luis_support: I'll take logs on webhook retries and verify if retries are causing duplicate requests. If so, we can filter dedupe server-side. Also can confirm which API keys were used for the bulk job.
ethan_m: quick data note — preliminary query: top 5 prompts show median token length ~1200, some outliers ~4500 tokens. The embed batch uses chunk size 1024 and overlaps, so cost multiplies. Suggest reducing overlap and chunk size to 512 where accuracy tolerates.
priya_k: Great. Jas, book the enablement session (30m) and loop in the customer success lead + engineering contact. Ben, can you do a one-time credit cushion and set a temp alert at 92%? Luis, please confirm duplicate retry count. Ethan, prepare a short doc with chunking/overlap recommendations I can share in the QBR.
ben_finops: Done — added +10% cushion and set alert at 92%. Will rollback by Friday unless asked to extend.
jas_solutions: Booking invite sent for 09:00 PST tomorrow, included: priy a_k, ethan_m, luis_support, ACT-993 eng lead. Agenda: prompt hygiene, chunking, caching, retry dedupe.
luis_support: Found 3k retry hits across the bulk job window — looks like exponential backoff misconfigured. Pushing a patch to drop duplicates and requeue once.
priya_k: Perfect. Also capturing customer feedback: they want clearer guidance on expected token costs per index job for the QBR slide. Ethan — can you export a 1-slide cost projection (best/likely/worst) using current burn rates and the proposed chunking change?
ethan_m: will do. I'll include projected savings if chunk size -> 512 and overlap -> 20%. ETA 2 hours.
priya_k: Thanks team. I'll consolidate notes for QBR and include the enablement follow-up + action log. Tagging next steps: @jas_solutions (enablement doc), @ethan_m (cost slide), @luis_support (retry patch), @ben_finops (credit/alert).
ben_finops: adding a short bullet for renewal risk: if spend pattern continues without adoption change, renew negotiation could include a usage cap. We'll surface mitigation in the QBR.
priya_k: Noted — will frame it as "operational optimization + short credit cushion" and invite renewal SME if needed. Closing thread until post-call updates.
